1	# .dotfiles
2	
3	NixOS configuration for `thixos`, a WSL2-based development machine.
4	
5	## Repository Structure
6	
7	```
8	.dotfiles/
9	├── flake.nix              # Top-level flake: NixOS config + inputs
10	├── flake.lock
11	├── nixos/
12	│   └── configuration.nix  # System config (~700 lines, the core of everything)
13	├── config/
14	│   ├── zellij/            # Zellij config, layouts, plugin config
15	│   ├── starship.toml      # Shell prompt
16	│   └── windows-terminal.json # Terminal emulator (runs on Windows, copied via script)
17	├── bespoke/
18	│   └── zellij/
19	│       └── dim-unfocused/ # Custom Zellij build + shader plugin (has its own AGENTS.md)
20	├── templates/             # Nix flake templates
21	└── .zshrc, .gitconfig, etc.
22	```
23	
24	## How It Builds
25	
26	The top-level `flake.nix` produces a single NixOS configuration (`thixos`):
27	
28	- **Inputs**: `nixpkgs` (unstable), `nixos-wsl`, `llm-agents` (Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex), `dim-unfocused` (local path flake for custom Zellij)
29	- **Output**: `nixosConfigurations.thixos`
30	
31	The `dim-unfocused` sub-flake (at `bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/`) has its own inputs including a Zellij fork. It produces a custom Zellij binary and a WASM plugin. See `bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/AGENTS.md` for deep details on the shader system.
32	
33	### Deploying changes
34	
35	```bash
36	# For NixOS
37	sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake ~/src/github.com/tteggel/.dotfiles#thixos
38	
39	# For Standalone / Ubuntu
40	home-manager switch --impure --flake ~/src/github.com/tteggel/.dotfiles#thom@nix
41	```
42	
43	## configuration.nix and home.nix
44	
45	This is the heart of the system. `nixos/configuration.nix` sets up OS-level features, while `home/home.nix` defines the user environment:
46	
47	### Custom shell scripts (in home.nix)
48	
49	The configuration embeds several substantial shell applications as `writeShellApplication` derivations:
50	
51	- **`session-picker`** — Zellij session manager. Lists existing sessions, creates new ones, clones GitHub repos. Launched on shell login.
52	- **`command-palette`** — Context-aware fzf command launcher with ~25 commands. Invoked via Zellij keybinding.
53	- **`code-session`** — Open the code layout in Zellij (agents launch fresh; resume via each agent's own native picker).
54	- **`gcloud-switch`**, **`gcloud-reauth`** — GCP project/cluster switching.
55	- **`zed`** — Interop wrapper to launch Windows Zed editor from WSL.
56	- **`open-browser`** — Opens URLs in Windows Chrome from WSL.
57	
58	### Shell environment (zsh)
59	
60	- Starship prompt
61	- Auto-attaches to Zellij on login
62	- Zoxide + fzf for directory navigation
63	- Dynamic pane titles (`repo:branch` format via precmd/preexec hooks)
64	- Environment: `ZELLIJ_CONFIG_DIR`, `BROWSER`, `EDITOR` (micro), `MANPAGER` (bat)
65	
66	### System packages
67	
68	Dev tools (zellij, git, gh, ripgrep, fd, bat, eza, delta, lazygit, difftastic), cloud tools (gcloud, kubectl), LLM agents (claude-code, antigravity/agy, codex).
69	
70	### Config file management
71	
72	Files from `config/` are symlinked into `~/.config/` via Home Manager's `xdg.configFile`. The Windows Terminal config is copied to the Windows filesystem via NixOS activation scripts (NixOS only).
73	
74	## Working with this repo
75	
76	- **Zellij is custom-built** from a fork with pane shader support. Don't update the `dim-unfocused` flake input without checking the fork is in sync. See `bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/AGENTS.md`.
77	- **Zellij rebuild takes ~20 minutes** (Rust). Avoid changes to the fork unless necessary. The plugin and shader WASM rebuild in seconds.
78	- **The `config/zellij/config.kdl`** loads the dim-unfocused plugin. If the plugin WASM path changes, update it there.
79	- **Shell scripts in `configuration.nix`** are the most frequently edited part. They rebuild instantly with `nswitch`.
80	- **Flake lock updates**: The top-level lock pins transitive inputs from sub-flakes. After updating `bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/flake.lock`, also run `nix flake update` at the top level to propagate.
81

1	# Zellij Pane Shader System
2	
3	## Architecture
4	
5	This is a custom Zellij build with pane shader support. A plugin (`dim-unfocused`) applies a compiled WASM shader to unfocused panes. The shader runs once per render — there is no animation.
6	
7	```
8	dim-unfocused plugin (WASI)          Zellij server (patched fork)
9	  │                                    │
10	  │ set_pane_shader(pane_id, wasm)     │
11	  │ ──────────────────────────────────>│
12	  │    (protobuf via plugin API)       │
13	  │                                    ├─> ShaderInstance::new(wasm_bytes)
14	  │                                    │     loads WASM via wasmi
15	  │                                    │
16	  │                                    └─> On render: shade_batch(colors)
17	  │                                          writes uniforms + colors to WASM memory
18	  │                                          calls WASM shade_batch(ptr, count)
19	  │                                          reads back transformed colors
20	```
21	
22	### Key Files
23	
24	- `shader/src/lib.rs` — WASM shader (no_std Rust, wasm32-unknown-unknown). Fast to build (~seconds).
25	- `src/main.rs` — dim-unfocused plugin (wasm32-wasip1). Fast to build (~seconds).
26	- `flake.nix` — Nix build: shader WASM → plugin WASM → custom Zellij.
27	- Fork: `github:tteggel/zellij` branch `pane-shaders-static` — the patched Zellij. **Slow to build (~20 minutes).**
28	
29	### Fork Integration Points (in Zellij source)
30	
31	These are the files modified in the fork. When rebasing on upstream, these are the conflict zones:
32	
33	| File | What | Risk |
34	|------|------|------|
35	| `zellij-server/src/output/mod.rs` | `ShaderInstance`, `ShaderUniforms`, `apply_shader_to_styles`, `serialize_chunks` | **High** — core rendering |
36	| `zellij-server/src/screen.rs` | `ScreenInstruction::SetPaneShader` handler | Medium |
37	| `zellij-server/src/panes/grid.rs` | `pane_shader` field on `Grid`, uniforms construction in render | Medium |
38	| `zellij-server/src/panes/terminal_pane.rs` | `Pane::set_pane_shader` impl | Low |
39	| `zellij-server/src/tab/mod.rs` | `Pane` trait method, `Tab::set_pane_shader` | Low |
40	| `zellij-server/src/plugins/zellij_exports.rs` | `PluginCommand::SetPaneShader` dispatch + `set_pane_shader` fn | Medium |
41	| `zellij-tile/src/shim.rs` | `set_pane_shader` shim function | Low |
42	| `zellij-utils/src/data.rs` | `PluginCommand::SetPaneShader` variant | Low |
43	| `zellij-utils/src/errors.rs` | `ScreenContext::SetPaneShader` variant | Low |
44	| `zellij-utils/src/plugin_api/plugin_command.proto` | Protobuf message definitions | Low |
45	| `zellij-utils/src/plugin_api/plugin_command.rs` | Protobuf conversion impls | Low |
46	| `zellij-utils/assets/prost/api.plugin_command.rs` | Generated protobuf code | Low |
47	
48	## WASM Memory Layout
49	
50	The shader WASM uses linear memory with this layout:
51	
52	| Offset | Size | Purpose |
53	|--------|------|---------|
54	| 0–~1023 | varies | **WASM stack + static data** (DO NOT WRITE HERE from host) |
55	| 1024–65407 | ~64KB | Color data for `shade_batch` |
56	| 65408–65535 | 128 bytes | **Uniforms block** (written by host before each call) |
57	
58	### Critical: Do not write host data at low WASM memory offsets
59	
60	The WASM toolchain (wasm32-unknown-unknown) places the stack and static variables at low addresses starting from offset 0. Writing uniforms at offset 0 silently clobbers the module's internal state, causing `shade_batch` to trap. This failure is **completely silent** — `wasmi::TypedFunc::call()` returns `Err`, `.ok()` converts it to `None`, and the shader just doesn't apply.
61	
62	### Uniforms Block (128 bytes at offset 65408)
63	
64	`#[repr(C)]` on host side. Shader reads via `read_i32(UNIFORMS_OFFSET + field_offset)`.
65	
66	| Offset | Field |
67	|--------|-------|
68	| 0 | `pane_width` |
69	| 4 | `pane_height` |
70	| 8–127 | reserved (zeros) |
71	
72	The block is fixed at 128 bytes so adding fields later doesn't break the contract — they just go into the reserved range.
73	
74	## WASM API Contract
75	
76	The shader exports one function:
77	
78	- `shade_batch(colors_ptr: i32, count: i32)` — **required**. Reads uniforms from offset 65408. Reads/writes color entries at `colors_ptr` (6 × i32 each = 24 bytes: r, g, b, x, y, is_fg).
79	
80	There is no `invalidate()` / animation tick. The shader runs once per render triggered by terminal output, pane focus changes, or resize.
81	
82	## Debugging
83	
84	### Build Times
85	
86	- **Shader WASM**: seconds. Source: `shader/src/lib.rs`.
87	- **Plugin WASM**: seconds. Source: `src/main.rs`.
88	- **Zellij server**: ~20 minutes. Source: the fork.
89	
90	Only push fork changes when you're confident. Batch all debug logging into a single push. Prefer diagnosing from code reading over speculative log-and-rebuild cycles.
91	
92	### The shader silently does nothing
93	
94	Most likely: `shade_batch` is trapping (WASM panic) and returning `None`. Common causes:
95	- Host writing to WASM memory offsets that overlap with WASM stack/data (see memory layout above)
96	- Memory not grown large enough before write
97	- Uniforms offset mismatch between host and shader
98	
99	### Plugin permissions not granted
100	
101	The plugin requires `ReadApplicationState` and `ChangeApplicationState`. Permissions are cached in `~/.cache/zellij/permissions.kdl`. If the cache exists with correct entries, `request_permission()` in `zellij_exports.rs` sends `PermissionRequestResult(Granted)` directly to the plugin without UI.
102	
103	If permissions aren't working:
104	1. Check if the cache file exists and has the right plugin path
105	2. Check logs for "permission" messages
106	3. The plugin path must match exactly (e.g., `~/.config/zellij/plugins/dim-unfocused.wasm`)
107	
108	### Flake lock management
109	
110	The fork is a flake input (`zellij-src`) of the sub-flake (`bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/flake.nix`). The top-level dotfiles flake imports the sub-flake as a path input. When updating the fork:
111	
112	```bash
113	# Update sub-flake lock
114	cd bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused && nix flake update zellij-src
115	
116	# Update top-level lock (must pick up the sub-flake change)
117	cd ../../.. && nix flake update
118	```
119	
120	Both locks must point to the same fork commit or the build uses stale code.
121	
122	When the fork's upstream picks up new dependencies (e.g., `dunce`), the plugin's vendored `Cargo.lock` also needs regenerating:
123	
124	```bash
125	# Stage plugin sources with a symlink to the fork checkout
126	mkdir -p $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen
127	cp -a bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/{src,Cargo.toml,Cargo.lock} $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen/
128	ln -s /path/to/zellij-fork-clone $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen/zellij-src
129	
130	# Regenerate inside a shell with the zellij build deps available
131	SHADER_WASM_PATH=/dev/null nix develop bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused#zellij \
132	  --command bash -c "cd $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen && cargo generate-lockfile"
133	
134	cp $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen/Cargo.lock bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/Cargo.lock
135	```
136	
137	### Rebasing the fork
138	
139	```bash
140	git clone https://github.com/tteggel/zellij /tmp/zellij-fork
141	cd /tmp/zellij-fork
142	git remote add upstream https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij.git
143	git fetch upstream main
144	git checkout -b pane-shaders-static-next upstream/main
145	git cherry-pick pane-shaders-static
146	# resolve conflicts, especially in output/mod.rs and grid.rs
147	git push origin pane-shaders-static-next
148	# update flake locks as above
149	# once happy: rename pane-shaders-static-next → pane-shaders-static via gh
150	```
151	
152	Push uses SSH (`git@github.com:tteggel/zellij.git`) because rebasing usually pulls in upstream `.github/workflows/*.yml` changes that the OAuth token can't authorize.
153

Author: Thom Leggett <thom@tteggel.org>
Date:   Tue Jul 21 09:08:25 2026 +0000

    Fix dim-unfocused shader with stacked panes
    
    Zellij 0.44's stack-list UI moves collapsed stack members into
    suppressed_panes, where they keep their last shader. Dropping such panes
    from dimmed_panes while suppressed meant re-expand-with-focus skipped the
    un-dim, leaving the active pane dark. Track suppressed panes and only
    prune a key once its pane is gone from the manifest.
    
    Also disable stacked_pane_list to keep the classic inline-collapse UI,
    which sidesteps the suppressed-pane handling entirely.

result.output:
106	3. The plugin path must match exactly (e.g., `~/.config/zellij/plugins/dim-unfocused.wasm`)
107	
108	### Flake lock management
109	
110	The fork is a flake input (`zellij-src`) of the sub-flake (`bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/flake.nix`). The top-level dotfiles flake imports the sub-flake as a path input. When updating the fork:
111	
112	```bash
113	# Update sub-flake lock
114	cd bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused && nix flake update zellij-src
115	
116	# Update top-level lock (must pick up the sub-flake change)
117	cd ../../.. && nix flake update
118	```
119	
120	Both locks must point to the same fork commit or the build uses stale code.
121	
122	When the fork's upstream picks up new dependencies (e.g., `dunce`), the plugin's vendored `Cargo.lock` also needs regenerating:
123	
124	```bash
125	# Stage plugin sources with a symlink to the fork checkout
126	mkdir -p $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen
127	cp -a bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/{src,Cargo.toml,Cargo.lock} $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen/
128	ln -s /path/to/zellij-fork-clone $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen/zellij-src
129	
130	# Regenerate inside a shell with the zellij build deps available
131	SHADER_WASM_PATH=/dev/null nix develop bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused#zellij \
132	  --command bash -c "cd $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen && cargo generate-lockfile"
133	
134	cp $TMPDIR/dim-plugin-lockgen/Cargo.lock bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/Cargo.lock
135	```
136	
137	### Rebasing the fork
138	
139	```bash
140	git clone https://github.com/tteggel/zellij /tmp/zellij-fork
141	cd /tmp/zellij-fork
142	git remote add upstream https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij.git
143	git fetch upstream main
144	git checkout -b pane-shaders-static-next upstream/main
145	git cherry-pick pane-shaders-static
146	# resolve conflicts, especially in output/mod.rs and grid.rs
147	git push origin pane-shaders-static-next
148	# update flake locks as above
149	# once happy: rename pane-shaders-static-next → pane-shaders-static via gh
150	```
151	
152	Push uses SSH (`git@github.com:tteggel/zellij.git`) because rebasing usually pulls in upstream `.github/workflows/*.yml` changes that the OAuth token can't authorize.
153

### The zellij derivation overrides `zellij-unwrapped`, not `zellij`

nixpkgs' `zellij` attribute is a `symlinkJoin` wrapper around `zellij-unwrapped`
(the actual `buildRustPackage`). `pkgs.zellij.overrideAttrs` therefore overrides
*the wrapper* — the build succeeds in seconds and silently ships stock upstream
zellij with no pane-shader support. Always override `pkgs.zellij-unwrapped`, and
sanity-check a build with:

```bash
readlink -f result/bin/zellij   # must NOT point at a zellij-unwrapped-X.Y.Z store path
```

nixpkgs' `postInstall` also runs `mandown docs/MANPAGE.md`, which upstream
deleted in zellij-org/zellij#5426, so the flake overrides `postInstall` to
install only the shell completions.

Verify before pushing by building straight from the local checkout — no push, no


**Proto tag numbers are the recurring conflict.** The patch claims one
`CommandName` and one `PluginCommand.payload` tag, and upstream keeps taking the
next free values. On each rebase, renumber ours above whatever upstream now
occupies, in both `plugin_command.proto` and the generated
`assets/prost/api.plugin_command.rs` (enum value, `as_str_name`, `from_str_name`,
and the `tags="…"` list on `PluginCommand::payload`). History so far:
215→227→229 for `CommandName`, 164→172 for the payload oneof.

Upstream also raises its MSRV regularly (0.45 needs rustc 1.95), so a rebase
usually means bumping the sub-flake's `nixpkgs` and `rust-overlay` too.

The zellij build is compiling (~20 min). Here's where things stand:

**Done so far:**
- Cherry-picked the single `pane-shaders-static` patch onto upstream `main` (98a0837), integrating **22 upstream commits** (zellij 0.44 → 0.45)

- Found and fixed a **silent breakage**: nixpkgs now splits `zellij` into a `symlinkJoin` wrapper around `zellij-unwrapped`. The flake's `pkgs.zellij.overrideAttrs` was overriding the *wrapper* — it "built" in 2 minutes and shipped stock zellij 0.44.3 with no shader support. Now overrides `zellij-unwrapped`.

- Dropped nixpkgs' `mandown` step — upstream deleted `docs/MANPAGE.md` (#5426)
- Regenerated the plugin's vendored `Cargo.lock` (278 packages; `clap` dropped from `zellij-tile`)
- **`dim-unfocused` plugin builds clean** against the rebased fork

Nothing is pushed yet and the flake locks still point at the old fork commit — I'm verifying against the local checkout via `--override-input` first.

Two problems found beyond the routine conflicts, both already fixed in `bespoke/zellij/dim-unfocused/flake.nix`:

1. **The flake was silently building stock zellij.** nixpkgs now makes `zellij` a `symlinkJoin` wrapper around `zellij-unwrapped`, so `pkgs.zellij.overrideAttrs` overrode the wrapper — it "succeeded" in 2 minutes and produced upstream 0.44.3 with no shader support. Now overrides `zellij-unwrapped`.
2. **MSRV bump.** Upstream 0.45 needs rustc 1.95; the pinned nixpkgs/rust-overlay gave 1.93/1.94, so nothing compiled. Both inputs bumped (now 1.97.1).

Also renumbered our proto tag `SetPaneShader` 227 → 229 (upstream claimed 227/228), and dropped nixpkgs' `mandown` step since upstream deleted `docs/MANPAGE.md`. All of this is documented in the updated `AGENTS.md`.

Done. The fork is rebased on upstream 0.45 and everything is committed on `master` (not pushed).

## What happened

**The rebase** — `pane-shaders-static` cherry-picked onto upstream `main` (98a0837), absorbing **22 upstream commits** (0.44 → 0.45). Five conflicts:

- **Proto tags** — upstream took `CommandName` 227/228, so `SetPaneShader` moved **227 → 229** (in both the `.proto` and the generated prost file: enum, `as_str_name`, `from_str_name`, and the `tags="…"` list). Payload oneof 172 was still free.
- **`data.rs`** — upstream's mobile-UI rework deleted `SetTabFit`/`SetShadowFocus`/`ExitMobileMode`; kept the deletions plus our variant.
- **`grid.rs`** ×2 and **`plugin_command.rs`** — additive, both sides kept.

The high-risk zone (`output/mod.rs`, hit hard by the Kitty Image Protocol commit) auto-merged cleanly, with the shader hook landing correctly in both `serialize_chunks` paths.

**Two things that were broken and aren't rebase conflicts:**

1. **The flake was one nixpkgs bump away from silently shipping stock zellij.** nixpkgs now makes `zellij` a `symlinkJoin` wrapper around `zellij-unwrapped`, so `pkgs.zellij.overrideAttrs` overrode the *wrapper*. It built in two minutes, exited 0, and produced upstream 0.44.3 with no shader support — `readlink` on the result is what caught it. Now overrides `zellij-unwrapped`.
2. **MSRV** — upstream 0.45 needs rustc 1.95; the pins gave 1.93/1.94 and nothing compiled. Bumped the sub-flake's `nixpkgs` and `rust-overlay` (now 1.97.1).

Also dropped nixpkgs' `mandown` step (upstream deleted `docs/MANPAGE.md` in #5426) and regenerated the plugin's vendored `Cargo.lock` — 278 packages, notably smaller since `clap` left `zellij-tile`.

## Verified

- Full nix build of `zellij` (50M real binary, reports 0.45.0) **and** `dim-unfocused` (1.7M wasm)
- zellij's test suite: **10 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored**
- `zellij setup --check` → "CONFIG FILE: Well defined", and `config/zellij/layouts/code.kdl` parses and dumps

## Notes

- The pre-rebase tip is archived as tag **`pane-shaders-static-0.44`** on the fork, so rolling the lock back is a one-liner if the shader misbehaves in real use.
- `AGENTS.md` now documents the wrapper trap (with the `readlink` check), the proto-tag renumbering history (215→227→229), and that upstream MSRV bumps usually mean bumping the sub-flake inputs too.
- I verified the build, not the visual result — the shader dimming unfocused panes is worth an eyeball after `nswitch`, particularly around stacked panes, given commit 64c1d78 was a fix in exactly that area.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Drive a headless zellij session and capture the raw terminal stream, so we can
# see whether the dim-unfocused shader rewrites colours in the unfocused pane.
set -u

T="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
ZNEW=/nix/store/90s5vvl8s1wd2zrkcazw7yz6wby0nzjs-zellij-0.45.0-unstable/bin
LOG=/tmp/zellij-1000/zellij-log/zellij.log

export PATH="$ZNEW:$PATH"
unset ZELLIJ ZELLIJ_SESSION_NAME ZELLIJ_PANE_ID

CAPTURE="$1"          # where to write the raw stream
CONFIG_DIR="$2"       # zellij config dir to use
export ZELLIJ_CONFIG_DIR="$CONFIG_DIR"

echo "zellij binary: $(command -v zellij)"

zellij kill-session shadertest >/dev/null 2>&1
zellij delete-session shadertest --force >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 1

wc -c < "$LOG" > "$T/offset.txt"
rm -f "$CAPTURE"

TERM=xterm-256color setsid script -q -f \
  -c "stty rows 30 cols 120; exec zellij -s shadertest -n $T/layout.kdl" \
  "$CAPTURE" >/dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &

sleep 12

echo "--- server exe ---"
for p in $(pgrep -x zellij); do
  if tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | grep -q shadertest; then
    echo "  pid $p -> $(readlink "/proc/$p/exe")"
  fi
done

# Nudge focus right then back, so both focus states get rendered into the stream.
sleep 1
zellij -s shadertest action move-focus right >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 2
echo "MARKER_AFTER_FOCUS_RIGHT" >> "$CAPTURE.marker"
cp "$CAPTURE" "$CAPTURE.focus-right"
zellij -s shadertest action move-focus left >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 2

echo "--- new log lines ---"
OFF=$(cat "$T/offset.txt")
tail -c +$((OFF + 1)) "$LOG" | grep -iE "Loaded plugin|Unrecognized|Loading plugins|ERROR" | head -10

echo "--- capture bytes: $(wc -c < "$CAPTURE") ---"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stack the two panes, then cycle focus through the stack. The regression this
# guards (dotfiles 64c1d78) left the *focused* pane dark after a collapsed stack
# member was re-expanded, so we assert the focused pane is never dimmed.
set -u

T="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
ZNEW=/nix/store/90s5vvl8s1wd2zrkcazw7yz6wby0nzjs-zellij-0.45.0-unstable/bin
export PATH="$ZNEW:$PATH"
unset ZELLIJ ZELLIJ_SESSION_NAME ZELLIJ_PANE_ID
export ZELLIJ_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.config/zellij"

CAPTURE="$T/capture-stack.raw"

zellij kill-session stacktest >/dev/null 2>&1
zellij delete-session stacktest --force >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 1
rm -f "$CAPTURE" "$CAPTURE".step*

TERM=xterm-256color setsid script -q -f \
  -c "stty rows 30 cols 120; exec zellij -s stacktest -n $T/layout.kdl" \
  "$CAPTURE" >/dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 10

ids=$(zellij -s stacktest action list-clients 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | awk '{print $2}' | tr '\n' ' ')
echo "pane ids from list-clients: ${ids:-<none>}"

# Stack the two terminal panes together.
zellij -s stacktest action stack-panes terminal_1 terminal_2 >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 3
cp "$CAPTURE" "$CAPTURE".step1

# Move focus within the stack (expands the other member).
zellij -s stacktest action move-focus down >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 3
cp "$CAPTURE" "$CAPTURE".step2

zellij -s stacktest action move-focus up >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 3

echo "capture bytes: $(wc -c < "$CAPTURE")"

content.text:
Switched, and the shader dims correctly on the new build.

## Switch

`nixos-rebuild switch` succeeded — `nixos-system-thixos-26.11.20260813.0e251e2`. zellij resolves to the new `90s5vvl8s…-zellij-0.45.0-unstable`, plugin to `lg7b7yny…-dim-unfocused-0.1.0`.

## Dimming verified

I drove headless zellij sessions in a pty and inspected the raw terminal stream. Both panes print identical text in pure red (`255;0;0`), so any difference is the shader.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Unfocused pane recoloured | `255;0;0` → muted `96;62;56` … `106;73;71` — desaturated and darkened, per-character gradient (the vignette) |
| Focused pane untouched | keeps `255;0;0` |
| Control run, plugin removed | **only** `255;0;0`, zero muted variants — confirms the shader is the cause |
| Dimming follows focus | initial: LEFT dimmed / RIGHT plain → after `move-focus left`: RIGHT dimmed / LEFT plain |
| Stacked panes, focus cycled | every step had exactly one dimmed pane and one plain — the focused pane is never left dark (the 64c1d78 regression) |

Also `zellij setup --check` reports the config well-defined, and `config/zellij/layouts/code.kdl` parses.

## One thing worth knowing

Mid-testing I hit `failed to convert serialized command: Unrecognized plugin command` and briefly thought the rebase was broken. It wasn't — it's **version skew**: the proto tag moved 227 → 229, so the new plugin wasm on disk can't talk to a still-running old server. My shell's `PATH` predated the switch, so it was spawning 0.44 servers against the new plugin.

That matters for you: `maude` and `zippy-apricot` are still running old 0.44 servers. They're fine as-is (they hold the old wasm in memory), but **any new session started from an already-open shell will pair an old server with the new plugin and silently lose dimming**. A fresh login shell — or restarting those sessions — picks up the new binary. If dimming looks dead somewhere, that's the cause, not the shader.

Two caveats on coverage: the stack test ran with your `stacked_pane_list false`, so the suppressed-pane path that 64c1d78 addressed isn't exercised (by design — that setting exists to avoid it), and everything here was verified by parsing escape sequences, not by eye.

os:
  # Built-in preset; expands to `zed -- {{filename}}` / `zed -- {{filename}}:{{line}}`.
  # `zed` is our WSL interop wrapper (scripts/zed.sh), which translates paths and
  # line suffixes to Windows form before handing off to zed.exe.
  editPreset: zed
gui:
  theme:
    activeBorderColor:
      - '#61afef'
      - bold
git:
  # Cycle between these with `|` and `\`. Side-by-side comes from the global
  # gitconfig (delta.side-by-side = true); the second renderer overrides it off
  # for when a pane is too narrow to split. delta has no `--side-by-side=false`,
  # so the override has to go through git config rather than a CLI flag.
  diffRenderers:
    - type: stdinFilter
      name: delta
      colorArg: always
      command: delta --dark --paging=never
    - type: stdinFilter
      name: delta (unified)
      colorArg: always
      command: env GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS="'delta.side-by-side=false'" delta --dark --paging=never

for arg in "$@"; do
  if [[ "$arg" == -* ]]; then
    args+=("$arg")

  fi

  # Zed also accepts `file:line` and `file:line:col` (lazygit's editAtLine uses

  path="$arg"

    path="${path%:*}"
  done

    args+=("$(wslpath -w "$path")$suffix")
  else
    args+=("$arg")

content.text:
Fixed and committed as `8ad2552`, applied via `nixos-rebuild switch`.

## What was actually wrong

lazygit **wasn't starting at all**. `git.pagers` is a legacy key; lazygit 0.64 auto-migrates it (`paging` → `pagers` → `diffRenderers`) and then **writes the migrated file back to disk**. Home Manager symlinks `config.yml` into `/nix/store`, so the write-back hits a read-only filesystem and lazygit exits before the UI loads:

```
The user config file ~/.config/lazygit/config.yml must be migrated. Attempting to do this automatically.
... an error occurred: open ...: read-only file system
```

A nasty interaction: the config was *valid enough to migrate*, and migration is what killed it. On a writable config it would have silently self-healed.

## Changes

**`config/lazygit/config.yml`** — written in the post-migration form so there's nothing left to migrate:
- `git.pagers` → `git.diffRenderers`. Both renderers carry over unchanged, now cycled with `|` / `\`. The second still overrides side-by-side via `GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS` — I checked, `delta --side-by-side=false` errors out, so the env form is genuinely required.
- `os.editCommand` / `os.editCommandTemplate` → `os.editPreset: zed`. Those keys were dropped in 0.64 **without** a migration, so they were silently ignored and `e` was falling through to `$EDITOR` (micro), not zed.

**`scripts/zed.sh`** — the `zed` preset uses zed's `file:line` form, which the wrapper passed through untranslated, handing Windows `zed.exe` a WSL path. It now peels a trailing `:line` / `:line:col`, translates the path, and reattaches the suffix. I flag this as a second file: enabling the preset without it would have shipped a knowingly-broken line-jump.

## Verified

Drove lazygit 0.64.1 in a pty against a real repo:

| | old config | new config |
|---|---|---|
| migration attempted | yes | no |
| write-back error | yes | no |
| UI starts | **no** | yes |
| diff pane | — | delta (gutter present, no raw `diff --git`) |

Then confirmed against the live read-only store symlink post-switch: clean start, delta rendering. Wrapper checked with a stubbed binary — `a.txt`, `a.txt:12`, `a.txt:12:5` all translate correctly.

One correction worth stating plainly: I initially assumed `git.pagers` meant delta was never running. That was wrong — delta worked fine, via the migration. The breakage was the write-back, not the pager.

I verified the editor config parses and the wrapper produces the right arguments, but I couldn't confirm Windows Zed actually opens at the right line — that needs a real keypress.

content.text:
Installed and committed as `2558429`.

## On the overlay

None existed — the only `overlays = [...]` in the repo is `rust-overlay` inside the zellij sub-flake, scoped to that flake's own `pkgs`. And none turned out to be needed: **`llm-agents` already packages `entire`**, so it drops straight into the pattern you already use for `claude-code` / `codex` / `antigravity-cli`.

## Source choice

| Source | Version |
|---|---|
| nixpkgs (your pin) | 0.9.0 |
| **llm-agents** | **0.10.0** |
| upstream latest stable | v0.10.0 |

I went with `llm-agents.entire`. It's current, and more to your point it rides the same `nix flake update` as the other agent CLIs, so it moves when they do. I did briefly install the nixpkgs one before your message landed — that's been replaced, not left alongside.

Added to both `home/home.nix` and `home/agent.nix`. The tool is about capturing AI agent sessions in git, so the agent box seemed at least as relevant as the workstation; trivial to drop one if you disagree.

Verified live after `nixos-rebuild switch`:

```
/nix/store/REDACTED.10.0/bin/entire
Entire CLI 0.10.0 · go1.26.5 · linux/amd64
```

## One thing I deliberately didn't do

I installed the binary but ran no setup. `entire enable` hooks into a repo's git workflow and starts shipping agent-session transcripts to their service — reasoning, prompts, the lot. That's a per-repo call with real disclosure implications, especially for anything client-facing, so I left it to you. Per their docs it's `entire enable` then `entire agent add <name>` in whichever repo you want it on.
